name: Mukae ni Kuru Onna no Ko
source:
A usual breakfast in the morning. Friend comes by to go to school together. He tells a short ghost story about a ghost girl who ways on the way from school to pick up different students.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
早上照常吃早餐。朋友过来一起上学。他讲述了一个简短的鬼故事，讲述了一个鬼女孩在放学的路上去接不同的学生的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
